history.summary: Freehold 4BR (1346sqft) in East Coast D15 at $1,486 PSF — a genuine discount to the project's $1,918 URA median PSF and well within the $1.8M-2.5M liquid band. Strong fundamentals: top-batch score 715, on-frontier, deep D15 buyer pool, Siglap TE MRT walkable.
history.rating_rationale: $2.00M for a freehold 1346sqft 4BR works out to $1,486 PSF vs URA median $1,918 — a ~23% discount, partly because it is a larger/efficient family layout but still attractive value for FH in D15. Score 715 / Elo 1457 with a strong 261-111 record and on-frontier. URA rate 2.0%/yr is depressed by new-launch bias flag (built 2022, only 23 txns); the real D15 freehold trajectory is better. Thomson-East Coast Line (Siglap 680m) plus East Coast lifestyle support both rental and resale.
red_flags: URA rate carries new-launch bias (built 2022, 23 txns) — treat 2.0% as unreliable
4BR family unit = narrower (though deep in D15) buyer pool than 2-3BR
catalysts: East Coast / Bayshore precinct lifestyle and continued D15 demand
Freehold tenure premium in a leasehold-heavy resale market

history.summary: The algo's bargain is a data artifact: the same listing URL is now marketed at $2.39M ($1,776 psf), not the $2.0M / $1,486 psf in the dossier, so the -37.4% age-adj 'cheapness' largely evaporates once the live price is used.
history.rating_rationale: The dossier's $2.0M / 1,346 sqft ($1,485.88 psf) does not match the live listing, which is now $2,390,000 ($1,776 psf) for this exact 1,346 sqft penthouse corner unit. Project recent resale runs ~$1,857-$2,409 psf (avg ~$1,962), so at the corrected $1,776 psf it is still somewhat below pool average — but that pool is dominated by small high-psf units, while this is a large penthouse that structurally trades lower psf; psf_cohort_txns=2 makes the -16.2% cohort discount unreliable. Once the stale price is corrected, the score-765 'deep value' thesis collapses, and per v3.4 priors a freehold tag is not a forward edge. With the bargain illusory and the contender being an atypical penthouse on a 2-transaction cohort, this is an Avoid rather than a buy.
red_flags: Stale/incorrect dossier price: live asking is $2.39M ($1,776 psf), ~20% above the $2.0M used to score it
Penthouse corner unit (atypical layout) — psf not comparable to the broader pool
Once repriced, the deep-value rationale that earned score 765 no longer holds
catalysts: Future Siglap TEL MRT (~490m) is a genuine location catalyst for the project
Freehold new-ish (2022) build in established East Coast enclave

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Trailing 2.02% CAGR (23 txns) is low and forward-irrelevant; the project's real story is the Siglap MRT catalyst, but that is already partly priced and does not rescue a unit bought at $1,776 psf as a 'discount'.
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Project yield ~3.2%; a large penthouse at $2.39M will yield below that and rent is thin for 4BR penthouses. Not a yield case.
